sections.heading: What is Corridor?
sections.content: Corridor is a comprehensive Business Orchestration Platform designed to streamline your financial operations. We unify payments, payroll, and employee benefits into a single, powerful operating system.

sections.heading: Why Corridor?
sections.content: Running a modern business requires juggling multiple tools for payments, HR, and accounting. Corridor replaces this fragmentation with a unified suite that handles everything from accepting customer payments to paying your employees instantly.

sections.heading: Key Benefits
list: Unified dashboard for all financial operations
Instant Early Wage Access (EWA) for employees

sections.heading: Step 1: Create Your Organization
sections.content: Sign up and create your organization profile. Add your business details, logo, and operating currency.

sections.heading: Step 2: Invite Your Team
sections.content: Navigate to the Team section and invite your finance, HR, and operations managers. Assign roles to ensure proper access control.

sections.heading: Step 3: Connect Payment Methods
sections.content: Link your bank accounts and mobile money wallets to start accepting payments and processing payouts.

sections.heading: Configure Settings
sections.content: Customize your experience by setting up default currencies, tax rates, and notification preferences.

sections.heading: Verify Identity
sections.content: Complete the KYC/KYB process to unlock higher transaction limits and advanced features.

sections.heading: Unified Payment Layer
sections.content: Corridor sits between your business and payment providers. We route transactions intelligently to ensure the highest success rates and lowest fees.

sections.heading: Smart Routing
sections.content: Automatically route payments through the best provider based on currency, amount, and reliability.

sections.heading: On-Demand Pay
sections.content: Give your employees financial freedom by allowing them to access a portion of their earned wages before corridor. This reduces financial stress and increases retention.

sections.heading: How It Works
list: Employees view earned wages in the Corridor mobile app
Funds are instantly disbursed to their mobile wallet
The amount is automatically deducted from their next paycheck

sections.heading: Employer Benefits
list: Zero impact on cash flow (optional pre-funding)

sections.heading: Connect Your Tools
sections.content: Corridor integrates with your favorite accounting, HR, and CRM software. Sync data automatically to keep your records up to date.

sections.heading: Automate Business Logic
sections.content: Use our visual workflow builder to automate repetitive tasks. For example, 'If a payment fails, send an email to the customer and create a task for the support team.'

sections.heading: Inventory, Payments & EWA
sections.content: Connect your point-of-sale, online store, and staff payouts so stock, sales, and wages stay in sync.

sections.heading: Frontline team experience
sections.content: Offer Early Wage Access for staff working shifts so they can handle emergencies without waiting for corridor.

sections.heading: Fleet & driver payouts
sections.content: Instantly disburse funds for fuel, tolls, and allowances while keeping a real-time view of spend per route.

sections.heading: Automated invoicing
sections.content: Generate and send invoices as soon as deliveries are completed, with reconciliation back to each customer.

sections.heading: Time tracking to invoice
sections.content: Track billable hours and convert them into professional invoices in a few clicks.

sections.heading: Retainers & subscriptions
sections.content: Set up recurring billing for retainers, support packages, and ongoing service contracts.

sections.heading: Staff scheduling & payouts
sections.content: Coordinate shifts, tips, and payouts for front-of-house and back-of-house teams in one place.

sections.heading: Guest payments
sections.content: Accept bookings, bar, and restaurant payments with unified reporting across your property.

sections.heading: Bank-grade protection
sections.content: We use strong encryption and follow PCI-DSS style practices to protect customer card and mobile money data.

sections.heading: Access control
sections.content: Use roles and approvals so only the right people can move money, issue refunds, or change payout details.

sections.heading: Stay aligned with regulation
sections.content: Configure limits and policies so Early Wage Access follows local rules and your HR policies in Kenya.

sections.heading: Respect customer and employee data
sections.content: Control who can view sensitive data and export reports with audit logs for every action.

sections.heading: Plan with real numbers
sections.content: Use real-time revenue and expense data to forecast cash flow and plan for upcoming obligations like payroll and tax.

sections.heading: Share insights
sections.content: Export or share dashboards with leadership so everyone is aligned on the current plan versus actuals.
